hero.caption: The Uganda National Museum Building is the First Modern Achitecture building of the 20th century in Uganda and one of the earliest cast-in-place concrete structures in Kampla. It influenced the design of other government and institutional buildings throughout the country. It was designed by a Ernst May german architect in 1947. uptodate the building is still authentic and still serves the purpose built for.
